paras: Application: Subaru BRZ (2012–2020, 2022+), Toyota GT86 (2012–2021), Toyota GR86 (2022+), Scion FR-S (2012–2016) – manual transmission only Part Type: Fuel hanger plumbing kit (returnless to return conversion) with microglass filter Part Number: 20-0966-05

The Radium 20-0966-05 Fuel Hanger Plumbing Kit converts the OEM returnless fuel system on the Subaru BRZ, Scion FR-S, Toyota GT86 and GR86 to a traditional return-style system. It connects directly to OEM or aftermarket fuel rails in both single and dual pump configurations. An 8AN PTFE hose feeds a Radium fuel filter with an integrated check valve, mounted under the vehicle on a chassis-specific bolt-on bracket, with an inline fuel pressure gauge secured to the filter.
hl: Return Conversion: Converts the OEM returnless system to a traditional return system
Single or Dual Pump: Connects directly to OEM or aftermarket fuel rails in single or dual pump configurations
Microglass Filter: 6 micron microglass element with integrated check valve – no separate check valve needed for fuel pressure hold-up
RA-Series Regulator: Adjustable Radium FPR with tool-less pressure adjustment
Inline Gauge: Fuel pressure gauge secures to the filter
PTFE Hose: 8AN and 6AN PTFE fuel hoses
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Hanger Plumbing Kit with Microglass Filter for Subaru BRZ/Toyota 86
